Knotty Ash — Liverpool, United Kingdom

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

Merseyside Police recorded 363 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 8.4 per 1,000 residents, the 17th highest rate of Liverpool's 30 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (7), drugs (7), vehicle crime (3); the evening/night score by violent crime (48), public order (14), anti social behaviour (12). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Knotty Ash safe?

Wandroz currently rates Knotty Ash in Liverpool as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Liverpool during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Liverpool at night. This rating is derived from Merseyside Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Knotty Ash safe at night?

At night, Knotty Ash is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Liverpool. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Knotty Ash a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Knotty Ash's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Liverpool) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
